# Selected-Authority Migration: Per-Increment Sweep

Before each no-PR increment push, freeze the candidate and retain receipts for:

1. Focused affected-root proofs, including both-store cells where applicable,
   and the committed finite codemod's tests and inert replay.
2. The exact debt ratchet, completed native-family census, descriptive registry
   (`TestPersistenceAuthorityFindingRegistry`) and hostile controls. Exact site
   identities may disappear but may not be added or reclassified as permission.
3. The existing 78 structural/retirement/boundary guards and applicable planner,
   partition and timing inventory checks.
4. Exact-head complexity analysis against the agreed master base.
5. `go run ./cmd/swarm-unused`, using the existing pinned native default/race/
   issue2413 reachability matrix. Record its exit status and remove dead helpers
   and imports, rather than adding suppressions or artificial callers. A local
   native pass is not the hosted Linux/Darwin union.
6. Source SHA, debt delta, actual executed roots/backend cells and any incomplete
   or failed receipts in the increment comment. Do not recast earlier receipts
   as exact-head qualification after another executable-source edit.

The unused check is mandatory alongside, not instead of, the existing sweep.
It does not request another tier run, alter workload coverage, or waive the
final integrated qualification obligations under #2542/#2151.

observation extraction. Removed it and its now-unused UUID import. The live

not suppressed or referenced artificially. Historical codemod before-snapshots
retain their old SQL expressions; the candidate overlay applies all reviewed
rewrites before type checking and does not need the obsolete live helper.
